Synopsis: A king is dying, and his sons are already at war. From Michael Hirst, the creator of Vikings, BLOODAXE opens in 927 AD, as the ailing King Harald Fairhair of Norway must name a successor. Erik Bloodaxe, the most famous warrior of the Viking world, is the ruthless heir sworn to the pagan ways, and his claim is challenged on every side. His greatest rival is his younger brother Haakon, raised in Christian Wessex under the ambitious King Athelstan and poised to return home backed by an English fleet. As the loyalties of his remaining brothers and the Jarls waver, Erik leans on the counsel and diplomatic skill of his wife Gunnhild, while in Denmark her father King Gorm plots to exploit Norway's instability. Faith and fate collide as the men who would crown Haakon demand he renounce his God to take the throne. Brother falls at the hand of brother, the old ways crumble, and the season builds toward an apocalyptic siege that threatens to engulf Erik's stronghold.

Synopsis: Sometimes the best comebacks are unexpected. 

In season two, Santi takes the next step in his pursuit of professional golf, only to discover how quickly the game changes when talent becomes expectation. As Santi chases his dream, Pryce finds himself wondering what might still be possible for him. Urged on by his former rival Clark Ross (Olyphant), Pryce does something nobody expects: he bets on himself, launching an improbable comeback in hopes of becoming the oldest golfer ever to win a major. But the road back proves far harder than he imagined. And the closer Pryce gets to the golfer he once was, the more he is forced to confront why he never fulfilled the promise everyone once saw in him. With brilliant new coach Amanda (Seehorn) and trusted caddie Mitts (Maron) in his corner, Pryce sets out to prove — to the golf world and, more importantly, to himself — that maybe he really was as good as everyone always said he was.

recentItems.title: "The Adaptation Makes Total Sense" The 'Carrie' Cast on Modernizing Stephen King's Iconic Story
recentItems.description:
Summer H. Howell, Samantha Sloyan, Amber Midthunder, Matthew Lillard, Josie Totah, Alison Thornton, Arthur Conti, and Joel Oulette sit down with Rotten Tomatoes correspondent Chris Tait to talk about their new Stephen King television adaptation, 'Carrie'!  Howell describes what it was like embodying the character of Carrie while avoiding watching iconic past performances, the cast shares what it was like working with an expert horror showrunner like Mike Flanagan, and they describe why an adaptation of this classic story is so pertinent for this generation.
